jobs.description:
Apicbase is a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to transform how the hospitality and food & beverage industry manages its operations. Our platform is trusted by the world's most ambitious restaurant groups, hotel chains, and foodservice operators and we're just getting started.
 

We're looking for a 
Strategic Account Manager who thrives in a high-growth environment, thinks commercially, works data-driven, and knows how to build lasting strategic partnerships with enterprise clients.
 

Your Role
 

You own a portfolio of key accounts and you take that ownership seriously. You're the strategic partner your clients didn't know they needed, and you make sure they always do.
 
 

•  

Embrace an agentic way of working: you leverage AI tools and automation to work smarter, move faster, and deliver more value to your clients and your team.
  

•  

Act as a trusted advisor not just a point of contact. You think ahead, flag challenges before they become issues, and bring solutions to the table.
  

•  

Retain and grow your client portfolio through proactive business reviews, health checks, and a sharp eye for risk and opportunity alike.
  

•  

Upsell and expand accounts by understanding your clients' strategic goals and connecting them to the full value of the Apicbase platform.
  

•  

Engage senior stakeholders across operations, finance, and C-level — you're comfortable holding strategic conversations at every level of an organization.
  

•  

Onboard and implement new enterprise clients with confidence, navigating complex setups and multi-stakeholder environments from day one.
  

•  

Drive adoption through data: you use platform insights, usage metrics, and KPIs to guide conversations and demonstrate ROI.
  

Your Profile
 
 

•  

Proven experience in account management, customer success, or a commercial role, ideally in SaaS, hospitality tech, or a B2B scale-up environment.
  

•  

Commercial mindset: you understand the full revenue cycle and know how to grow an account strategically, not just maintain it.
  

•  

Data-driven by nature: you're fluent in dashboards, KPIs, and business insights, and you use data to back every recommendation.
  

•  

Strong with complexity: large implementations &  multiple stakeholders - you don't shy away, you step up.
  

•  

Stakeholder management at its best: you build trust quickly, communicate with clarity, and know how to align different interests.
  

•  

Scale-up mentality: you're energized by change, comfortable with ambiguity, and thrive without a corporate playbook.
  

•  

Curious about technology:  AI, automation, agentic workflows: you're not just aware of these trends, you actively apply them.
  

•  

Native Dutch speaker with strong English skills. French is a definite plus.
  

•  

A team player at heart:  you enjoy being around driven, like-minded colleagues and thrive in an office environment (Antwerp) where energy, ideas, and ambition are contagious.

What you do

 
• 
You research new applications and functionality for business use cases.

 
• 
You build new processes as well as optimize existing ones.

 
• 
You rollout the template to new factories and countries.

 
• 
You work closely together with the business process owners.

 
• 
You participate in the blueprint and fit-gap.

 
• 
You understand the business processes and requirements.

 
• 
You convert them into a functional design.

 
• 
You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.

 
• 
You document and test the functionality.

 
• 
You support the business during acceptance and go-live.

 
• 
You play a key role in all phases from the beginning till the end.

 
• 
You work with the latest SAP technologies and applications (including S/4 Hana).

Who you are

 
• 
You have built up profound knowledge of SAP SD (sales and distribution)

 
• 
You are familiar with the business processes and their approach in SAP

 
• 
You have developed analytical skills

 
• 
You have a proactive and solution oriented mindset

 
• 
You prefer working in an informal no-nonsense style

 
• 
You work independently and collaborate in dialogue with colleagues

 
• 
You are interested in a manufacturing environment

 
• 
You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe

 
• 
You speak English (Dutch or French is a plus)

 
• 
You are able to debug programming code

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers

• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays

• Handling payments and operating the cash register

• Providing information about the product range

• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates

• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn

• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)

• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)

French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is continuing to build and strengthen its own organization. To support our customers and sales activities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France, we are looking for a Sales Business Supporter.
 

These are newly created positions that offer the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. During your onboarding, you will work closely with colleagues from both Wygwam and our parent company to gain a thorough understanding of our customers, systems, and processes. Once this foundation is established, you will play an important role in improving the way we work and helping to build a future-proof support organization.
 

As a Sales Business Supporter, you will be a key link between customers and internal departments such as Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. You will support the complete customer journey, combining customer service, commercial support, process coordination, and administrative follow-up. Your contribution will help ensure excellent customer experience while supporting efficient business operations.
 

In this role, you will work in an international environment with colleagues from several European countries. You will report to a manager based in Denmark and collaborate with stakeholders throughout the organization. If you enjoy taking ownership, working across different functions, and contributing to a business undergoing transformation, this could be the perfect next step in your career.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Support end-to-end customer and sales processes across Belgium, the Netherlands, and France. 

• Handle daily customer inquiries and provide professional follow-up through the appropriate communication channels. 

• Process customer orders accurately and ensure timely administrative follow-up. 

• Manage customer returns and coordinate with relevant internal departments to ensure efficient resolution. 

• Maintain customer, product, and pricing information in SAP and ensure data accuracy at all times. 

• Manage commercial agreements, pricing structures, and bonus schemes in accordance with company guidelines. 

• Monitor delivery performance and support the resolution of delivery-related issues when required. 

• Act as the primary link between customers and internal stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Logistics. 

• Support product launches, pricing updates, and future SAP-related developments. 

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the implementation of more efficient ways of working. 

• Work accurately with data across multiple systems while maintaining a high standard of quality and consistency. 

• Ensure customers receive a professional, timely, and positive experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 

• Collaborate closely with colleagues across departments and countries to achieve shared objectives. 

• Participate actively in meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities throughout the organization.  

 

 

• You have experience in Sales Support, Customer Service, Operations, Business Support, or a similar commercial role. 

• You are fluent in Dutch and French, both spoken and written. 

• You have a professional level of English and can communicate confidently in an international environment. 

• You enjoy taking ownership and consistently follow tasks through to completion. 

• You are comfortable working in a changing environment where priorities may shift. 

• You have a structured and organized way of working with strong attention to detail. 

• You have a customer-focused mindset and enjoy building positive relationships with customers and colleagues. 

• You are proactive and solution-oriented, always looking for opportunities to improve processes. 

• You are resilient and motivated by the challenge of helping build new ways of working while learning from existing processes. 

• You have a good understanding of business processes and administrative workflows. 

• You are confident working with data and managing information across multiple systems. 

• You have strong Excel skills and are comfortable working with the wider Microsoft Office suite. 

• Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is considered a strong advantage. 

• You enjoy collaborating across different functions and working with diverse teams.

Wygwam, a division of the Niko Group, is dedicated to delivering innovative and intelligent electrical solutions for modern buildings. We work closely with architects, consultants, and installers, to integrate technology seamlessly into architectural concepts and functional environments. Both Niko Home Control as our lighting control portfolio belong to your responsibility.

For this role, we are looking for two electricians or hands on specialists who are ready to take the next step in their career and move into a more project-based and commercially oriented pre-sales role. Your electrical experience and interest in building technology will help you understand customer needs, interpret technical information and translate it into accurate project proposals and quotations.
 

The pre-sales technicians we are looking for are responsible for preparing project proposals and quotations for customers, based on information gathered from tenders, customer requests and input from sales colleagues. You’ll work across the relevant product groups within the Wygwam portfolio and play a key role in ensuring customers receive accurate, clear and timely project support.
 

In this role, you’ll handle project-related customer inquiries through different channels, mainly by phone and email. You’ll make sure every request is followed professionally, within the agreed deadlines, and with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and customer satisfaction. To achieve this, you’ll work closely with colleagues in sales, technical teams and other internal departments.
 
 

• Create project proposals for customers based on tenders, customer input and information gathered from sales colleagues. 

• Prepare quotations based on approved project proposals, as well as direct requests from wholesalers, customers or colleagues. 

• Handle customer inquiries related to project support through relevant channels, mainly by phone and email. 

• Maintain project mailboxes and ensure every customer receives a reply within 24 hours. 

• Follow up customer requests within the agreed deadline and take action when another solution is needed. 

• Register all relevant data in the CRM system. 

• Save and organize all relevant project documentation according to the agreed structure. 

• Ensure that every project proposal follows the department guidelines and contains all required information. 

• Keep your calendar up to date with planned project proposals and other relevant tasks to support smooth collaboration with colleagues. 

• Carry out all assignments with a strong focus on quality, accuracy and clear documentation. 

• Work in a structured and systematic way, aiming for error-free results while continuously improving processes and output. 

• Ensure customers have a positive and professional experience in every interaction with Wygwam. 
 

• You have a strong interest or knowledge in building automation and the standards, protocols and technology used. 

• You are structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time without losing overview. 

• You have strong communication skills and can translate technical information into clear explanations for both customers and colleagues. 

• You have a team-oriented mindset and enjoy working closely with sales and technical teams. 

• ·You are customer-focused and proactive in understanding customer needs and providing technically sound solutions. 

• You work accurately and have a strong sense of responsibility for the quality of your work. 

• You are comfortable using standard office software such as Outlook, Excel and Word. 

• You are familiar with digital tools related to daily administrative and project follow-up tasks. 

• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written. 

• You have basic to intermediate knowledge of English, sufficient to understand internal communication and participate in meetings. 

• Fluency in French, both spoken and written, is considered a strong plus.

Who we are 
 

OTIV is a Ghent-based company leading the autonomous revolution in rail. We are on a mission to increase safety and efficiency of railway operations by teaching rail vehicles to drive autonomously. By making trains more efficient and safer, we actively contribute to a modal shift and a greener future. We bring this vision to life by a unique focus on the most challenging environments such as cities, shunting yards and industrial sites. Thanks to high-profile partners and world-leading clients such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF Group, ArcelorMittal and CAF we deliver the future of railway operations today.
 

 
 

OTIV is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals and in which personnel processes are merit-based and applied without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, or other protected characteristic. OTIV strives to create an environment in which all employees feel confident in their ability to bring their authentic selves to work and secure collaborating with colleagues and customers.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

Als 
Finance & Admin Specialist neem je ownership over de financiële administratie van OTIV: facturatie, procure-to-pay en ondersteuning bij onze maandelijkse, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen. Naast de cijfers breng je energie en structuur naar onze administratieve backbone: je houdt processen draaiende en mensen ondersteund. Je vormt een sterk team met Marthe (Admin Specialist met focus op People & Operations).
 

Ben jij iemand die detailgericht en samenwerkingsgericht is, onze bedrijfsprocessen met overtuiging wil opnemen, en zowel houdt van de nauwkeurigheid van finance als van de variatie die we te bieden hebben? Apply now!
 

 
 

Tasks and responsibilities
 

As Finance & Admin Specialist at OTIV you will
 

Finance (50%)
 
 

• Book incoming and outgoing invoices and ensure accurate processing 

• Manage the full PO-to-invoice flow 

• Support monthly, quarterly and annual closings together with the accountant 

• Assist in reporting actuals, budget and forecast, and follow up department and company budget 

• Handle payment processing, expenses and record-keeping 

• Administer company insurance matters  

Procurement & logistics
 
 

• Run the full procure-to-pay process: sourcing, receiving, invoicing 

• Place orders with suppliers and follow up to ensure on-time delivery 

• Take ownership of shipments (domestic and international) 

• Maintain accurate records in Odoo, including stock management  

Office & compliance
 
 

• Manage e-inboxes and handle incoming requests 

• Manage client site access, clearances and documentation 

• Administer office onboarding, car park, and PPE 

• Support ISO 9001 processes and audit documentation 

• Provide general administrative support and help coordinate events  

Furthermore, you will form a strong administrative team with Marthe (Admin Specialist with a focus on People & Operations).

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor in accountancy or finance (or equivalent through experience) 

• 3+ years in a financial-administrative role 

• Confident with the numbers: closings, budget follow-up, procure-to-pay, invoicing 

• Hands-on with Odoo or comparable ERP and strong in Excel 

• Genuine passion for office management and general operations: you like keeping things running and people supported 

• Structured, accurate, and able to own end-to-end processes 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• Proactive and pragmatic, thrives in a fast-moving scale-up 

• Affinity with compliance and process improvement 

• Curious about AI and automation: you actively look for ways to streamline and automate administrative and finance processes  

• Fluent in Dutch & English (other languages are a plus)  

Nice to have:
 
 

• Previous experience in a fast-paced & broad administrative team, ideally in a tech or scale-up environment. 

• Experience in international shipping (export documentation,...) 

• Experience in People/HR processes (payroll, ...)

We are looking for an experienced auto body technician for a company specializing in cars.

What are your tasks?

- You repair and replace damaged bodywork and car parts on vehicles.

- You carry out sheet metal and welding work.

- You will align and assemble parts.

- You will prepare surfaces and ensure a neat finish before spraying, so that the vehicle is safe and aesthetically pleasing again.

Working hours:

Monday to Thursday: 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 3 p.m.

What do we expect from you?

- You speak Dutch or English

- You have one year of experience as a bodywork technician or in a garage

- You have your own car (a bicycle is also possible if you live nearby)

We are looking for a glass installer for a leading window and door company in Anzegem. In this role, you will assemble high-quality, durable custom-made aluminum and PVC products.

• You have a technical education or relevant experience in construction
• You work with precision and have a sharp eye for detail
• You think logically to solve problems during installation
• You handle stress well and stay calm when working with fragile glass
• You can work independently and make your own decisions
• You speak fluent Dutch or English

• You install various types of glass panels into aluminum windows and doors
• You inspect the quality of the products before they are shipped
• You report directly to the aluminum production manager

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for a Purchase Order Manager. You will report to the Finance Manager.

This is not a procurement role. Instead, it is a finance-focused position where accounting knowledge, financial controls and process governance are essential.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

• 
Partner closely with Accounting to support accurate financial reporting, month-end close and reconciliation activities.

• 
Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality operations.

• 
Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and business integration projects.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of Purchase-to-Pay processes, financial controls and operational efficiency.

• 
Act as the key contact for Finance Operations, providing expert support to internal stakeholders.

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in accounting, finance, economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
Several years experience in accounting/controlling.

• 
3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

• 
SAP MM/FI, S/4HANA, advanced Excel, and strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

jobs.occupation: Pilot Line Process Engineer – Atomic Layer Deposition
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

The Pilot Line Engineer is responsible for: 
 
 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention.  

• Troubleshoots issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up.  

• Investigates recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions.  

• Keeps focus on quality and reproducibility, monitoring stability and taking actions in case of process fluctuations.  

• Designs experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation.  

• Works in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• Works in a two-shifts system (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sa/Su) out of 4.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or in Engineering or equal to this by experience, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset.  

• You are able to rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice.  

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude.  

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required.  

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards. 
   
 

•  

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Skilled in DFMEA, DFM, DFA, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. 
   
 

•  

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies. 
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•  

Design tests and prototypes required to validate analyses, and correlate simulation results with experimental data.
   
 

•  

Perform root cause analyzes of product and process issues and provide simulation driven recommendations for design improvements.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

For a large-scale industrial project in the 
Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced 
Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Inspector.
 

You will join an international project environment within the petrochemical industry, where 
English is the main working language. Your focus will be on ensuring that all electrical and instrumentation works are executed safely, correctly and in accordance with project specifications, applicable standards and approved documentation.
 

Your role
 

As an E&I Inspector, you will be closely involved in the construction, installation and pre-commissioning phases of the project. You will spend a significant amount of time in the field, following up contractors and verifying the quality and compliance of the E&I installations.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Inspecting electrical and instrumentation installations during construction and completion 

• Verifying installations against approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and relevant standards 

• Checking cable routing, cable trays, cable pulling and termination 

• Inspecting junction boxes, field instruments, panels, switchgear and other E&I equipment 

• Checking instrument installation, impulse tubing and associated hook-ups 

• Verifying grounding, bonding and earthing installations 

• Performing and witnessing electrical and instrumentation tests 

• Following up loop checks, continuity tests, insulation resistance tests and functional testing 

• Verifying installations in hazardous areas and checking compliance with 
ATEX requirements 

• Reviewing inspection and test records, punch lists and construction documentation 

• Identifying non-conformities and following up corrective actions with contractors 

• Supporting mechanical completion and pre-commissioning activities 

• Coordinating closely with construction, engineering, QA/QC and commissioning teams
